About PGPCAS
At
PGP College of Agricultural Sciences (PGPCAS)
, we take pride in being a center of excellence in agricultural education and research. Established in 2013, our college is approved by the Government of Tamil Nadu, affiliated with
Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU)
, Coimbatore, and recently accredited by the
Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) –
a testament to our commitment to quality and standards in agricultural education.
Our 120+ acres green campus, set against the scenic Kolli Hills and surrounded by rural farmland, offers an ideal learning environment. We also utilize our 250-acre main campus on NH7 in Paramathi for extensive field-based training.
We offer
B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
and
Diploma in Agriculture
programs that blend strong academics with practical experience. At PGPCAS, we are dedicated to shaping future-ready agricultural professionals who are innovative, ethical, and equipped to lead sustainable rural and agricultural development.
